checks.policy_text:
Extracted values must reference a real OCR text fragment and a verified quotation. Coordinates are retained only when Docling supplies them. Human corrections retain the prior value and the actor, timestamp and reason. Invalid or truncated extraction requires review. Subtotal, tax and total additionally require an unambiguous association with an approved label in company_context.yaml. Same-row context uses actual OCR boxes and retains each original fragment. The occurrence of a number alone does not verify its field meaning; ambiguous candidates remain visible with a null field value. Hints never supply missing values or override checks.

EVIDENCE v1.2.0 permits repairing an amount citation only within the actual OCR row anchored by the model's evidence ID. Exactly one fragment must contain the candidate number, and an approved label must uniquely establish its role. Balance due / amount due alone does not establish invoice total. checks.message: Inspect uncertain fields and confirm their meaning against the original document.
checks.policy_text:
Extracted values must reference a real OCR text fragment and a verified quotation. Coordinates are retained only when Docling supplies them. Human corrections retain the prior value and the actor, timestamp and reason. Invalid or truncated extraction requires review. Subtotal, tax and total additionally require an unambiguous association with an approved label in company_context.yaml. Same-row context uses actual OCR boxes and retains each original fragment. The occurrence of a number alone does not verify its field meaning; ambiguous candidates remain visible with a null field value. Hints never supply missing values or override checks.

EVIDENCE v1.2.0 permits repairing an amount citation only within the actual OCR row anchored by the model's evidence ID. Exactly one fragment must contain the candidate number, and an approved label must uniquely establish its role. The original model claim stays separate from the verified quotation and actual source fragment. No document-wide number search or arithmetic-derived total is used. Balance due / amount due alone does not establish invoice total. Legacy saved claims may have their single numeric value separated from a known label/currency wrapper; this never supplies currency or a missing amount. Explicit cached revalidation preserves human corrections and already verified fields, records changes in review_events, and invalidates old decisions when the revision changes.

checks.policy_text: Verify the supplier by an exact approved tax identifier and compatible legal name or explicitly approved alias from the versioned supplier profile. A similar name or equal amount is insufficient. Demo identifiers are deliberately fictional.

checks.message: Select a valid order context; supplier and any explicit document PO must agree.
checks.policy_text: Automatically select an order only from an explicit document PO number and verified supplier identity. A user-selected order is separate review context and never becomes a document-extracted PO. An explicit conflicting document PO blocks approval. Candidate orders for a verified supplier are shown; even a single candidate is not automatically chosen when the document PO is absent. Multiple candidates require a human selection.

checks.policy_text: Invoice and purchase order currencies must agree. This demo supports AUD, USD, EUR and GBP, each with a policy equality tolerance of 0.01 currency units. Unsupported currencies require review.

checks.message: Invoice and order must explicitly share the same tax basis.
checks.policy_text: Both totals must explicitly use the same tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive basis. Unknown basis requires review.

checks.message: Cannot compare totals until order, currency and tax basis are verified.
checks.policy_text: Use Decimal to compare the invoice and order totals. Absolute difference at most 0.01 passes for supported currencies. There is no percentage allowance. Show the signed difference and document evidence.

checks.message: Not evaluated: insufficient components or unknown tax/currency basis.
checks.policy_text: For an inclusive total, compare subtotal plus tax with total when all three are available. Missing optional components are not evaluated; contradictory available components require review. For an exclusive total, compare subtotal with total.

checks.message: Not evaluated: a complete, evidenced set of invoice lines is unavailable.
checks.policy_text: Only evaluate line arithmetic when extraction explicitly confirms completeness and all quantities, unit prices, line totals and subtotal have verified evidence. Otherwise mark not_evaluated. Contradictory complete lines require review.
